mapper.select: SELECT place_id, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE content LIKE '%혼밥%' OR content LIKE '%혼자 먹%' OR content LIKE '%혼자 오%') AS solo, count(*) FILTER (WHERE content LIKE '%조용%') AS quiet, count(*) FILTER (WHERE content LIKE '%분위기 좋%' OR content LIKE '%분위기가 좋%' OR content LIKE '%분위기 맛집%') AS mood, count(*) FILTER (WHERE content LIKE '%데이트%') AS date, count(*) FILTER (WHERE content LIKE '%가성비%') AS value, count(*) FILTER (WHERE content LIKE '%웨이팅 없%' OR content LIKE '%웨이팅없%' OR content LIKE '%대기 없%') AS no_wait FROM retrip_review WHERE place_id IN #{placeId} GROUP BY place_id
